record.title: Evaluate public reproducibility and select the next useful tooling boundary
record.intent: Prefer demonstrated reuse and clear limits over adding speculative abstractions.
requirements: Independently review the synthetic provenance and copy-paste procedure, verify remote CI and preserve the existing independent adversarial fixtures.
Recheck the authorized deadline and choose a bounded offline successor from a concrete gap or record a final checkpoint.
acceptance: The public example is reproducible and any next work has a documented reason.
